summary: PAA filed a routine 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing completion of a $1.5B public debt offering: $700M 6.750% Series A and $800M 7.000% Series B Junior Subordinated Notes due December 15, 2056. Interest pays semi-annually from June 15, 2027, with a first reset in 2031 and 2036, respectively, at Five-Year Treasury plus spread, floored at the initial rate. Notes rank junior to senior debt and are unguaranteed; no board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. This is an ordinary capital-markets takedown, not a special situation, despite hybrid-equity-like subordination and extension features.
